name: releaseguard
description: Scans a dataset/model directory for PII and secrets with Presidio, redacts what it finds, and packages a public-release bundle: a Hugging Face dataset/model card and an EU AI Act Art. 53(1)(d) training-data-summary template, generated from the scan results.

dependencies.detection_engine: Presidio (https://github.com/data-privacy-stack/presidio) -- ReleaseGuard is a packaging layer on top of Presidio, not an independent detector
